title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Worked Case Sheet: The Amount an Alignment Comeback Credit Is Figured On
content:
The amount an alignment comeback credit on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is figured on follows the order's check record:

- where the order's **first alignment check** found the alignment out of spec and the correction was made at that visit, it is the correction charge plus the alignment check charge;
- where a **later out-of-spec check** was corrected at its visit, it is the correction charge plus half (0.5) the alignment check charge, the half rounded to the cent, half up;
- **otherwise** it is the correction charge alone.

## Records read

- The order's alignment checks: the result of check number 1 and whether the alignment was corrected in the same visit, and, for every check, whether a correction was made at that visit.
- The order's calibration money history: the alignment correction charge and the alignment check charge.

## Cases (hypothetical: alignment correction charge 129.95 USD, alignment check charge 59.95 USD)

| Check record on the order | Amount figured on |
|---|---|
| Check number 1 out of spec, corrected at that visit | 129.95 plus 59.95, that is 189.90 |
| Check number 1 in spec; check number 2 out of spec, corrected at that visit | 129.95 plus 29.98 (half of 59.95 is 29.975, rounded half up), that is 159.93 |
| No check recorded as corrected at its visit | 129.95 |

## Points of judgement

- The first case turns on check number 1 alone: it must both have found the alignment out of spec and have been corrected at that same visit.
- In the second case only the half of the alignment check charge is rounded; the correction charge is taken as it stands.
